Why US & UK enterprise teams are moving to eBPF in 2026 🚀🐳

Traditional sidecars add latency and crash risks. eBPF runs natively in the Linux kernel:
• ⚡ Sub-millisecond latency
• 🛡️ Built-in kernel safety
• 🔌 Zero code changes

Ditch heavy sidecar proxies for zero-overhead security.
